name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Yume no Owari ni
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 夢の終わりに
source:
Jinguuji is tormented by hideous dreams of his past. The mystery begins as Yoko unwittingly decides to investigate a requested case.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
神宫寺被关于往昔的可怕噩梦折磨。洋子在不知情的情况下决定调查一桩委托，由此揭开了谜团的序幕。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
